guide.summary: Clear water with two stone islands.
guide.biology: Open water mixes dissolved food and gases quickly.
guide.rules: All water with stone circles at (42,45) and (83,82), radius 9. Light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every water cell.
guide.example: A good place for swimmers, algae and surface colonies.
